The composition is an extreme close-up of her hand, centered in the frame, with the brim of the straw hat at the top, the blue sky taking up about 70% of the background, and the grass blurred at the bottom. In the foreground, the fingers and the straw texture of the hat are in focus. In the midground, her arm is extended from near to far.
